assets.description: A 1.4 m chrome coat rail on four castors with five coats hung on it in red, blue and green. The castors are named nodes on their own axles and roll; the coats are cloth and are modelled, never animated.

assets.name: Crockery Crate (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A slatted crockery crate, 0.56 m by 0.4 m, packed with two stacks of plates and six blue mugs, with a blank red label field on the end. It is the crate the cups live in between events.

assets.name: Flower Arrangement in a Jug (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.5 m flower arrangement in a white jug: eight stems with leaves and round heads in red, yellow and white. It is the thing on the welcome table and in the middle of every round table.

assets.name: Folding Sign Board (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.62 m by 1 m folding A board: two charcoal leaves on a chrome hinge with a blank red face on the front and a blank green one on the back, and a white band across the head. The front leaf is a named node and tips on the hinge when the wind catches it.

assets.name: Folding Trestle Table (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.8 m by 0.75 m folding trestle table at 720 mm: a beech faced top with an aluminium rim on a charcoal folding frame. The frame is modelled in the open position; the folded table is its own model.

assets.name: Folding Trestle Table, Folded (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The same trestle table folded flat, 120 mm deep, with its legs lying against the underframe. It stacks on the trolley or leans against a wall between events.

assets.name: Glass Rack (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.5 m square glass rack: a charcoal crate with wire dividers and nine half pint glasses standing in it. It is what the glasses are carried out to the bar table in.

assets.name: Hall Ceiling Pendant Light (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 380 mm enamelled pendant light on an 860 mm flex with a ceiling rose: a white shade with a warm yellow inside and a brass gallery. Modelled hanging from y=0 with the shade at the bottom, so the scene lifts it until the rose meets the roof beam.

assets.name: Hall Entrance Lobby Door Module (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The hall wall module with the entrance lobby pair in it: two blue leaves with tall vision panels and chrome pull handles, a stained lining and a glazed overlight above the head. The leaves hang on the hall face and swing in, so the lobby stays clear.

assets.name: Hall Fire Exit Door Module (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The hall wall module with a 1.6 m by 2.1 m fire exit pair in it: two green leaves on push bars in a lined opening, with a blank green exit sign over the head. The leaves hang near the outer face and swing outward, the way a fire door has to.

assets.name: Hall Lectern (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.1 m stained oak lectern: a shaped base, a column, a sloping reading top with a brass book stop, a small reading light and a blank red front panel with no crest or lettering on it.

assets.name: Hall Notice Board with Posters (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.2 m by 0.9 m cork notice board in a stained frame, pinned with six abstract posters in red, blue, yellow, green and white. Every poster face is a blank coloured field with no readable text on it. Modelled with its base on y=0, so the scene lifts it up the wall.

assets.name: Hall Panel Radiator (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1 m by 0.58 m double panel hall radiator with thirteen convector fins, a top and bottom rail, two wall brackets and a brass thermostatic valve. Modelled with its base on y=0, so the scene lifts it to its mounting height off the skirting.

assets.name: Hall Roof Beam Bay (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: One bay of a village hall roof: a 10 m stained tie beam, two rafters up to a ridge at 1.9 m, a king post, struts, five purlins carrying the next bay and steel straps at the feet. Bays repeat on the 2 m module and rest on y=0, so the scene lifts them to the wall head.

assets.name: Hall Wall Clock (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 340 mm brass rimmed hall clock: a domed case, a white dial with twelve batons and hour and minute hands stopped at a quarter past ten. The hands are geometry and do not turn. Modelled with its base on y=0, so the scene lifts it up the wall.

assets.name: Jumble Sale Table (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.5 m jumble sale table: a cloth laid trestle with three piles of folded clothes, a table lamp, a vase and a couple of odd mugs, and a blank folded price card. The clothes are cloth and are modelled, never animated.

assets.name: Kitchen Cooker (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 600 mm freestanding kitchen cooker: a white body with a dark hob and four burner rings, a control splash back with four knobs and a red indicator, and an oven door with a dark glazed window on a chrome rail handle. The door is a named node on its bottom edge and falls open.

assets.name: Kitchen Counter Run with Sink (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 2 m kitchen counter run at 900 mm: a white carcass on a blue plinth under a stainless worktop with an inset sink, a pressed drainer, a brass mixer tap and two cupboard fronts on rail handles. The cupboard fronts are geometry and do not open.

assets.name: Kitchen Crockery Shelf (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.2 m two tier kitchen shelf on charcoal brackets, stacked with plates, saucers and nine mugs in red and blue. Modelled with the brackets on y=0, so the scene lifts it onto the wall above the counter.

assets.name: Kitchen Fridge (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.45 m white kitchen fridge on a recessed plinth with three wire shelves, a bottle and a pack inside, a full height chrome handle and a blank blue badge panel. The door is a named node on its hinge stile and swings open.

assets.name: Mop and Bucket (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.4 m mop and bucket: a yellow bucket on four castors with a wringer and a handle, a mop stood in it and a red cleaning box on the rim. The castors are named nodes on their own axles and roll.

assets.name: PA Speaker on a Stand (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.8 m PA speaker on a tripod stand: a charcoal cabinet with a chrome driver grille and a tweeter horn on a telescopic pole with folding legs, and a red status band across the foot of the baffle.

assets.name: Parquet Hall Floor Tile (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 2 m square parquet hall floor tile, 50 mm deep: a chamfered sub floor with herringbone blocks laid over it in two tones of honey and stained oak. Tiles couple on a 2 m grid, so a hall floor of any size is a run of them.

assets.name: Parquet Hall Floor Tile with Border (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The same parquet tile with a stained border band along two edges, for the margin a hall floor keeps round its perimeter or the line a badminton court is marked on.

assets.name: Raffle Prize Table (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The same cloth laid trestle dressed as a raffle prize table: a bottle, a wrapped box, a biscuit tin, a pot plant, three books of tickets and a mug for the money. Every label field is blank.

assets.name: Round Banquet Table with Cloth (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.6 m round banquet table at 750 mm under a floor length white cloth with a green hem band and green and red ring bands on the top. The cloth is modelled, never animated: a hanging cloth is not reachable with one rigid node transform.

assets.name: Row of Six Linked Chairs (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A row of six chairs linked seat to seat with chrome row bars, 3 m long, seats alternating blue and red. One model for a row of seating set out for a concert or a meeting.

assets.name: Serving Hatch Wall Module (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The hall wall module with a 1.6 m serving hatch in it: a stained serving shelf running through to the hall side, a lined opening, a stainless roller shutter on eleven slats and the hood it rolls up into. The shutter is a named node and lifts straight up behind the hood.

assets.name: Serving Hatch Wall Module, Shutter Up (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The same serving hatch with the shutter already rolled up into its hood and the counter open to the hall, for a hall laid out mid event. The shutter stays a named node but holds this pose, so it ships no clips.

assets.name: Stack of Folded Tablecloths (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.4 m pile of folded tablecloths on a board: five white, three red and two green, each fold sitting a little askew on the one below. Cloth, so it is modelled and never animated.

assets.name: Stack of Ten Stacking Chairs (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: Ten of the same stacking chairs stacked one in another, 1.22 m tall, leaning back the way a real stack does. One model for the pile that lives against the wall between events.

assets.name: Stage Curtain Rail with Drapes (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 4 m free standing stage drape stand: a chrome track on two uprights with a red pelmet and a yellow trim band, and two gathered red drapes parted over the middle of the stage. The drapes are cloth: they are modelled and never animated.

assets.name: Stage Platform Module with Steps (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: The same stage module with a 1.3 m pair of treads down the front and a chrome grab rail either side, for the end of a run where performers get up onto the stage.

assets.name: Tea and Coffee Tray Set (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.52 m stainless tray laid for tea and coffee: a red tray liner, a white teapot, a green coffee pot, three mugs and a sugar box. One model for what comes through the hatch at the interval.

assets.name: Tea Urn on a Table (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.1 m cloth laid table with a 30 litre stainless tea urn on it: a domed lid, a brass tap over a drip tray, a red ready light, a stack of saucers, three mugs and a teapot. The tap is geometry and does not turn, and the cloth is modelled, never animated.

assets.name: Tombola Drum on a Stand (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.56 m hexagonal tombola drum on a charcoal cradle at 920 mm: a red barrel with brass end plates, a yellow hatch with a catch, a crank handle and a ticket tray under it. The drum, its hatch and its crank are one named node on the cradle axle and turn together.

assets.name: Trestle Table Trolley (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.9 m chrome table trolley loaded with five folded trestle tables stood on edge, on four castors. The castors are named nodes on their own axles and roll; the tables on it are one with the trolley.

assets.name: Upright Piano (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.46 m upright piano in stained case work: a fall over three octaves of modelled keys, a blank red front panel, three brass pedals on a lyre board and a hinged top lid. The lid is a named node on the case back edge and lifts; the keys do not move.

assets.name: Village Hall Honours Board (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.1 m by 0.86 m stained oak honours board with a moulded pediment, an inset panel and a header with ten blank gilt name strips on it. Every strip is deliberately blank, so no real person or place is named. Modelled with its base on y=0, so the scene lifts it up the wall.

assets.name: Village Hall on Fete Day (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 14 by 10 metre village hall in the middle of an event, laid on the pack's own parquet tiles inside its own walls and roof beams: a five module stage at the far end with steps at both ends, drapes across the back of it and the piano, the lectern and the speakers on it; the...

assets.name: Village Hall Stacking Chair (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.44 m village hall stacking chair with a seat at 450 mm: a bent charcoal steel frame in one tube a side with a blue moulded shell seat and back. It is the chair a hall owns two hundred of, and it stacks.

assets.name: Village Hall Stage Platform Module (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 2 m square demountable stage platform at 600 mm: a parquet faced deck with a stained front nosing, a recessed black skirt and four adjustable feet. Modules couple side to side, so a stage of any width is a run of them.

assets.name: Village Hall Wall Module (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 2 m by 3.2 m village hall wall module: cream painted plaster over a stained dado rail, a white skirting and a high window with a glazing bar and a moulded cill at 2 m. Modules butt on the 2 m module, so a hall wall of any length is a run of them.

assets.name: Wall Mounted Water Boiler (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 0.52 m wall mounted water boiler: a white cased tank with a dark control face, a red heating light, a brass tap over a drip tray and two wall brackets. The tap is geometry and does not turn. Modelled with its base on y=0, so the scene lifts it to its mounting height.

assets.name: Waste and Recycling Bins (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A pair of 0.78 m wheeled bins side by side, one green for waste and one blue for recycling, each on two wheels with a push bar and a hinged lid. Each lid is a named node on its back edge and lifts.

assets.name: Welcome Table with a Cash Tin (Village Hall and Community Events)
assets.description: A 1.2 m welcome table at the door: a cloth laid trestle with a blue hem band, an open cash tin with a note tray and a coin in it, a fan of leaflets, a pen and a small blank standing sign on a block.
